from datetime import datetime
sheet = 'Audited data'
start_clip = datetime(2028, 6, 7, 9, 0)
end_clip = datetime(2028, 6, 7, 17, 0)
rows = range(408, 420)
worker_costs = {}
for r in rows:
    w = cell(sheet, f'B{r}')
    s = cell(sheet, f'C{r}')
    e = cell(sheet, f'D{r}')
    rate = num(sheet, f'E{r}')
    clipped_start = max(s, start_clip)
    clipped_end = min(e, end_clip)
    if clipped_start < clipped_end:
        hours = (clipped_end - clipped_start).total_seconds() / 3600.0
        cost = hours * rate
        worker_costs[w] = worker_costs.get(w, 0.0) + cost
best_worker = sorted(worker_costs.keys(), key=lambda x: (-worker_costs[x], x))[0]
result = best_worker
